detail.longDescription: A typo in a PDF and no Word file to fix it in. Retyping the whole document isn't the answer. New guide on editing the text in the PDF itself on an iPhone with myPDF: how to tell real text from a scanned page (scans can't be edited), how to check the result before sending, and when you shouldn't edit at all, like a signed document. https:// my-pdf.net/blog/edit-text-in-p df-on-iphone/ # PDF # iPhone # Productivity
